PromptLibrary__Meta.PromptLibrary__Description: Single source of truth for the prompt library taxonomy. Defines every category, sub category, model target, status type and variable input type used by the AI Prompt Library mini app. Editing this file changes the navigation rail, the editor dropdowns and the filter chips. Nothing is hard coded in the application modules.

ImageGeneration.Category__Description: Prompts that produce or transform still imagery - visualisations, concept work, whitecard conversions and presentation graphics.

WhitecardImage.SubCategory__Description: Clean untextured massing and whitecard studies straight out of SketchUp.

ConceptImageGeneration.SubCategory__Description: Early stage exploratory imagery generated from a written brief rather than existing geometry.

CgiGeneration.SubCategory__Description: Full photorealistic CGI output intended for client presentation and planning submissions.

WhitecardToCgi.SubCategory__Description: Conversion prompts that take a fixed whitecard render and dress it into a photorealistic image without altering the geometry.

PresentationGraphics.SubCategory__Description: Line drawings, ink illustrations, watercolour washes and other stylised presentation treatments.

InteriorVisualisation.SubCategory__Description: Internal room views, material studies and furnished interior imagery.

SiteContextAndLandscape.SubCategory__Description: Landscaping, planting, boundary treatment and wider site context imagery.

ImageRepairAndUpscale.SubCategory__Description: Clean up, upscale, de-noise and correction passes over existing imagery.

TextRefinement.Category__Description: Prompts that rewrite, tighten, proof and restructure written material - client letters, planning statements and design narratives.

ClientCorrespondence.SubCategory__Description: Emails, letters, fee proposals and general client facing writing.

PlanningStatements.SubCategory__Description: Design and access statements, heritage statements and planning justification text.

ProofreadAndTighten.SubCategory__Description: Grammar, clarity and concision passes that keep the original voice intact.

ToneAndStyleRewrite.SubCategory__Description: Shift register, formality or house style without changing the underlying facts.

SummariseAndExtract.SubCategory__Description: Condense long documents, pull out actions, and structure unstructured notes.

VideoEditing.Category__Description: Prompts covering moving image work - walkthrough animation, shot direction, voiceover scripting and post production.

WalkthroughAnimation.SubCategory__Description: Camera moves, fly throughs and animated presentation sequences.

ShotDirection.SubCategory__Description: Shot lists, framing instruction and scene by scene direction.

VoiceoverAndScript.SubCategory__Description: Narration scripts, timing notes and presenter copy.

PostProcessing.SubCategory__Description: Colour grading, transitions, titling and final polish instructions.

CodeAndAutomation.Category__Description: Prompts used when building web apps, SketchUp plugins and data tooling.

AppScaffolding.SubCategory__Description: New app skeletons built to the Noble Architecture module and naming conventions.

RefactorAndReview.SubCategory__Description: Code review, tidy up and restructuring passes over existing modules.

SketchUpRubyPlugins.SubCategory__Description: Ruby extension work against the SketchUp API.

DataAndJsonTransforms.SubCategory__Description: Reshaping project data files, schema work and bulk data edits.

ResearchAndAnalysis.Category__Description: Prompts for investigation work - regulations, products, precedent and comparative analysis.

BuildingRegsAndPlanning.SubCategory__Description: Approved Document interrogation, planning policy and permitted development questions.

ProductAndMaterialResearch.SubCategory__Description: Specification comparison, product sourcing and material performance checks.

PrecedentAndCaseStudy.SubCategory__Description: Comparable schemes, appeal decisions and design precedent gathering.

NanoBanana.ModelTarget__Description: Google image generation and editing model.

Claude.ModelTarget__Description: Anthropic Claude - text, code and document work.

ChatGptText.ModelTarget__Description: OpenAI ChatGPT for written and analytical work.

ModelAgnostic.ModelTarget__Description: Works acceptably across any capable model.

Active.StatusType__Description: Proven prompt in regular working use.

Draft.StatusType__Description: Work in progress - not yet trusted for client output.

Archived.StatusType__Description: Superseded but retained for reference. Hidden from default searches.

TextArea.InputType__Description: Long form free text entry across several lines.

Select.InputType__Description: Pick one value from a defined option list.

Toggle.InputType__Description: Boolean switch resolving to one of two strings.
